election_identity.verification: The requested date and office are the target identity; no 2026 Governor race record or provider election ID was returned by the inspected sources.

provider_family: Pennsylvania Department of State electionreturns.pa.gov (official source; live machine-readable endpoint not verified); civicAPI v2 (candidate only, unverified)

endpoints.official_candidate_api: https://www.electionreturns.pa.gov/api/ElectionReturn/GetGeneralElectionData (direct request without parameters returned HTTP 404; required query signature and election ID not established)

source.official_results_claims: Pennsylvania DOS says federal and state results are posted on electionreturns.pa.gov after 8 p.m. on election night; local county/city results may be on county election board sites.
source.handbook_claims: County boards submit ballot-count text files; the DOS results site is continually updated as counties provide returns and displays county-level results.
source.civicapi_documentation_claims: Public, no authentication, described as free; attribution required for non-personal projects.
source.civicapi_faq_claims: Provider says results are aggregated from election authorities, with active-election updates every 5–10 seconds; free without registration or API key and requires attribution.

fetches.result: Response body was an Incapsula anti-bot challenge page, not the election-results application; it exposed no app scripts or election metadata. No challenge bypass was attempted.

county_coverage.note: Official documentation describes county-submitted, county-level election results, but no live 2026 race response or county rows could be inspected. Coverage of the requested Governor race is not verified.

license.official_source: No reuse license for the live endpoint was established during this investigation. Access was blocked by the site challenge.
license.civicapi_access: Provider documents the API as unauthenticated and free.
license.civicapi_attribution: Attribution required for non-personal use; link to or name civicAPI.

limitations: No verified unauthenticated live feed for Pennsylvania's November 3, 2026 Governor race was established in this investigation.

The official homepage returned an anti-bot challenge page. The provided candidate API path returned 404 without query parameters; its correct signature and election ID could not be discovered from the page.
civicAPI race search timed out and its status endpoint returned HTTP 502, so neither its race ID nor region_results county coverage could be checked.
Do not treat either candidate API URL as a working feed until a race record and county-level live result response are observed.

The official election-results documentation describes county-submitted returns and county-level display; it does not establish that results were available at fetch time or grant a specific data license.

preferred_verified_source.message: 67 counties with published returns. Source times apply to the published race feed; individual local update times are not supplied. Unofficial counts; no forecast or expected-vote estimates are included.
